mapper.select: SELECT o.o_num AS "o_num", MIN(o.u_member_id) AS "u_member_id", MIN(o.o_name) AS "o_name", MIN(o.o_phone) AS "o_phone", MIN(o.o_date) AS "o_date", MIN(o.o_status) AS "o_status", MIN(o.o_delivery_state) AS "o_delivery_state", MIN(o.o_delivery_date) AS "o_delivery_date", MIN(o.o_payment) AS "o_payment", SUM(o.o_price) AS "o_price", MIN(o.o_address) AS "recv_addr", MIN(o.o_request) AS "recv_request", MIN(o.o_zip_code) AS "o_zip_code", MIN(o.o_payment_key) AS "o_pay_no", CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS "o_pay_datetime" FROM order_tbl o WHERE o.o_num = #{oNum} GROUP BY o.o_num

SELECT o.o_num AS "o_num", o.pd_id AS "pd_id", o.o_count AS "qty", o.o_price AS "price", p.pd_name AS "pd_name", p.pd_image_url AS "pd_image_url" FROM order_tbl o JOIN product_tbl p ON p.pd_id = o.pd_id WHERE o.o_num = #{oNum} ORDER BY o.pd_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_tbl r JOIN product_tbl p ON p.pd_id = r.pd_id JOIN user_tbl u ON u.u_member_id = r.u_member_id WHERE 1=1
AND p.pd_pet_category =
1 2 p.pd_pet_category
AND r.r_score = TO_NUMBER(#{rate})
AND r.r_regDate >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND r.r_regDate < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( LOWER(p.pd_name) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' OR LOWER(u.u_nickname) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' OR LOWER(r.r_content) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' )

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.*, ROWNUM rn FROM ( SELECT r.r_num AS "r_num", r.pd_id AS "pd_id", r.r_content AS "r_content", r.r_score AS "r_rate", r.r_regDate AS "r_regdate", u.u_member_id AS "u_id", u.u_nickname AS "u_nickname", p.pd_name AS "pd_name" FROM review_tbl r JOIN product_tbl p ON p.pd_id = r.pd_id JOIN user_tbl u ON u.u_member_id = r.u_member_id WHERE 1=1
AND p.pd_pet_category =
1 2 p.pd_pet_category
AND r.r_score = TO_NUMBER(#{rate})
AND r.r_regDate >= TO_DATE(#{from}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND r.r_regDate < TO_DATE(#{to}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND ( LOWER(p.pd_name) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' OR LOWER(u.u_nickname) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' OR LOWER(r.r_content) LIKE '%'||LOWER(#{q})||'%' )
ORDER BY r.r_num DESC ) t ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}

SELECT r.r_num AS "r_num", r.pd_id AS "pd_id", r.r_content AS "r_content", r.r_score AS "r_rate", r.r_regDate AS "r_regdate", r.r_img AS "r_img", u.u_member_id AS "u_id", u.u_nickname AS "u_nickname", p.pd_name AS "pd_name" FROM review_tbl r JOIN product_tbl p ON p.pd_id = r.pd_id JOIN user_tbl u ON u.u_member_id = r.u_member_id WHERE r.r_num = #{rNum}
SELECT A.* , ROWNUM FROM ( SELECT u_member_id, u_id, u_name, u_address, u_email, u_birthday, u_nickname, u_regdate FROM user_tbl WHERE u_show='Y' ORDER BY u_regdate DESC ) A WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = '강아지' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "dog_count", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN p_type = '고양이' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "cat_count", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN p_gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "male_count", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN p_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "female_count", NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN p_neutered = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "neutered_count" FROM pet_tbl
